name: topview-3d-builder
description: Build, check and render 3D director scenes on your own machine with the topview-3d-cli command: characters, poses, props, cameras and keyframes, fully offline.

interface.shortDescription: Local 3D scenes, rendered on your machine
interface.longDescription: Scene3D turns scene descriptions into 3D director scenes you can check and render locally. The topview-3d-cli command keeps each project in a folder on your machine, places characters, poses, props and primitives from a built-in offline asset library, sets up cameras and keyframes, checks layout and camera coverage, and renders frames and contact sheets with a local browser. No account and no uploads; after a one-time browser download it works offline.
defaultPrompt: Build a scene with a character next to a box and render a front view
Move the camera to a low angle and render frames 0 and 48 as a contact sheet
Pose the character waving and show me the result
